name: takopi-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is takopi, a Telegram bridge for coding-agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code,
OpenCode and Pi): it runs an engine runner for each message and translates the engine's JSONL stream into
takopi events, renders progress and final messages for Telegram, routes messages to engines, projects and
git worktrees through directives, reply context and resume lines, serializes runs per thread, and loads
engines, transports and commands as plugins.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the takopi package (every module under src/takopi/), together with the reference pages under docs/reference/ (except the four engine stream cheat sheets docs/reference/runners/*/*-cheatsheet.md) and the explanation pages under docs/explanation/, and the docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.14 with takopi's dependencies, pytest and pytest-xdist installed, and has
no network access; `takopi` is imported from `/workdir/src`. No engine CL
